Meter Sight by CT Electrical Sales

See the electrical system—not just the meter.

Meter Sight organizes live electrical data around a familiar one-line experience, helping facility teams move from scattered readings to actionable system visibility.

A clearer view of power

Metering that follows the way your system is built.

Meter Sight brings breaker-level measurements, equipment context, alarms and historical information together in a clean interface. Operators can start at the one-line, locate the equipment that matters and move into detailed readings without losing system context.

Designed for facilities such as hospitals, data centers, manufacturing plants and campuses, the platform supports teams responsible for reliability, energy visibility and electrical-system performance.

Metering capabilities

From phase values to facility-wide context.

The system can be organized around the measurements and operating views that matter most to each facility.

Voltage by phase

Line-to-line and line-to-neutral voltage, including VLL and VLN for each phase.

Current & loading

Per-phase current, loading and demand visibility at monitored equipment.

Power & energy

kW, kVA, kvar, power factor, frequency, demand and accumulated energy.

Interactive one-lines

Navigate electrical equipment from a system-oriented view with drill-down detail.

Breaker-level context

Associate measurements with breakers and distribution equipment for faster understanding.

Trends & history

Review operating patterns, compare time periods and investigate abnormal conditions.

Alarms & events

Bring attention to conditions that require review and preserve event context.

Remote visibility

Give authorized facility personnel a consistent view of electrical performance.

Custom system views

Organize pages around the facility, equipment hierarchy and monitoring priorities.
